summary: W. P. Carey Inc. filed a 424B5 preliminary prospectus supplement for a public offering of senior unsecured notes. The specific principal amount, interest rate, and maturity date are left blank as placeholders, with pricing and settlement expected around July 2026. The notes will rank equally with existing senior unsecured debt, have no sinking fund, and will not be listed on any exchange. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No special-situation mechanics, advisor, or board recommendation are disclosed. Watch for final pricing terms.
